skill.name: higgsfield-soul-id
skill.description: Guides users through creating a Higgsfield Soul Character from face photos. It helps choose a Soul variant, submit training through the Higgsfield CLI, wait for completion, and prepare the identity for image or cinematic generation.
skill.summary: Train reusable Higgsfield identity models from user-provided face photos.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, CLI flags, or product reference IDs. The audit confirms the remote installer pipe-to-shell command, the related network dependency, command-construction risks, and sensitive biometric photo handling. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-sh installer with a pinned release, checksum verification, or package-manager install steps that require explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: CLI examples interpolate user-provided names, prompts, paths, and IDs into shell commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require argument-array execution or clear quoting and escaping rules before passing user values to Bash.

remediation.issue: The workflow uploads face photos to train a reusable identity model without a consent or privacy preflight.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to confirm photo ownership, subject consent, upload destination, and acceptable use before training starts.

content.value_statement: Creating a consistent AI identity from face photos requires the right model variant, photo set, and CLI steps. This skill guides Higgsfield Soul training from photo intake through a ready-to-use identity reference.
actual_capabilities: Collects the Soul name and 5 to 20 face photo paths or uploaded image IDs.
Chooses the image or cinematic Soul variant based on the user goal.
Submits Soul training through the Higgsfield CLI and waits for completion.
Explains common training failures and photo quality fixes.
Shows how to reuse a trained Soul in later Higgsfield image or video generation.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI, an authenticated account, and a paid Basic or higher plan.
Uploads face photos to Higgsfield, so users must have rights and consent.
Does not provide one-shot face swaps or fictional named-character creation.
Training can take minutes and may fail when photos are low quality or too similar.

use_cases.title: Personal AI Identity Setup
use_cases.description: Create a reusable Soul Character for consistent self-portraits and avatar imagery across Higgsfield generations.

use_cases.title: Cinematic Character Continuity
use_cases.description: Train a cinematic-ready identity model before generating video scenes that need the same person across shots.

use_cases.title: Client Avatar Production
use_cases.description: Guide client photo intake, training submission, and troubleshooting for repeatable branded visual assets.

output_examples.input: Training failed after I uploaded my photos.
output_examples.output: The likely issue is photo quality or variety. Replace group, filtered, repeated, or occluded photos with clear single-person images.

best_practices: Confirm consent and photo rights before uploading any face images.
Use 8 to 12 clear photos with varied angles, lighting, expressions, and distances.
Verify Higgsfield login and plan status before starting a training job.
anti_patterns: Uploading group photos, heavy filters, sunglasses, or repeated poses.
Starting training before confirming the user has a paid Higgsfield plan.
Sharing raw Soul reference IDs in chat when a name reference is enough.

faq.question: What is a Higgsfield Soul Character?
faq.answer: It is a reusable identity model trained from face photos for Higgsfield image and video generation.

faq.question: How many photos should I provide?
faq.answer: The skill accepts 5 to 20 photos. A set of 8 to 12 varied, clear photos is recommended.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Higgsfield plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Soul training requires a Basic or higher Higgsfield plan.

faq.question: Can this create a one-shot face swap?
faq.answer: No. This skill trains a reusable identity model. One-shot image workflows should use a generation skill instead.

faq.question: Can I train a Soul for another person?
faq.answer: Only use photos when you have the subject consent and the right to upload them for model training.

faq.question: What happens after training finishes?
faq.answer: The trained Soul can be reused in Higgsfield image or cinematic generation workflows that support Soul IDs.
